title: KeenPage AI Task Map by Occupation
description: How much of the everyday work in 2,000 occupations can AI help with? 25,000 tasks across 38 industries, checked against the duties listed for each job in official occupation data, one row per occupation. Headline: official duties covered (54% in the average occupation). Version 2026-11-09.1 corrects the first 2026-11-09 release, which left the official duties cited by shared common tasks out of the numerator (45%). Model-assisted estimates, not survey results.
